name: Project creation and onboarding
summary: How projects come into being: deal-led first projects created by Track3D, sales order forms, customer-created projects, and the company details collected at onboarding.

roles.note: Order-form upload is limited to Track3D sales users, which is a separate flag rather than a project role.

actions.action: Upload and extract a sales order form

nfr.statement: Time from Track3D creating a deal-led project to the customer receiving their invitation.
nfr.open_question: Is same-day onboarding a commitment? Who is told if it slips?

requirements.title: Track3D creates the first project for a deal
requirements.statement: Enterprise and non-enterprise deals usually concern a project. Track3D creates that first project and invites the customer as project admin or as company-wide super-admin.

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: A signed deal for a customer's site
acceptance_criteria.then: Track3D creates the project and invites the customer's contact as project admin or company super-admin

requirements.title: The customer can set up a Track3D-created first project immediately
requirements.statement: For the usual first project that Track3D creates, the invited customer can start project setup straight away. This does not change the rule that customer-submitted projects show details only while pending (PROJ-REQ-008).

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: A first project created by Track3D for a deal
acceptance_criteria.then: They can begin setup at once (users, designs, configuration)

requirements.title: A first project starting more than 30 days out can't be set up yet
requirements.statement: Today an approved or initiated project is in Pre-Setup while its start date is more than 30 days away, and setup actions are blocked until then, including for a Track3D-created first project.

dispute.summary: PROJ-REQ-002 says the customer can set up a Track3D-created first project immediately. The access-stage rule (PROJ-REQ-014) only opens setup 30 days before the start date, whatever the status. Product to decide in DEC-023.

sources.title: Direct code reads during USER migration (2026-10-29)

acceptance_criteria.given: A Track3D-created first project, approved, with a start date 60 days from today
acceptance_criteria.when: The invited customer tries to add a design
acceptance_criteria.then: (Current behaviour) The action is refused because the project is in Pre-Setup

requirements.title: How a new project's first status is chosen
requirements.statement: A placeholder project created by sales starts as Initiated. A complete sales-created project starts Approved, in construction. Other projects start Pending approval, unless company, regional or allowlist rules approve them automatically.
open_checks: The exact roles and allowlist values for auto-approval depend on environment and data

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer with no auto-approval rule creates a project
A sales user creates a complete project for a deal
acceptance_criteria.then: Its status is Approved and its construction phase is In-construction

requirements.title: Sales order forms are read to prefill the company
requirements.statement: Only Track3D sales users can upload a signed order form. It must be a PDF of at most 10 MB. Its fields are extracted unless extraction is turned off, and the company is matched by email domain, or reported as "no company". A match is not membership approval or proof of a signed agreement.
open_checks: The MIME check is not content validation

acceptance_criteria.given: A sales user uploads a 12 MB PDF order form
An order form whose contact email domain matches no company
acceptance_criteria.then: The result reports "no company" rather than guessing one

requirements.title: Company name and logo at project onboarding
requirements.statement: The project onboarding form has company name and logo fields. If the company already exists they are filled in automatically; otherwise the user enters them.

acceptance_criteria.then: Company name and logo fields are shown and work

acceptance_criteria.given: The user's company already exists, with a logo
acceptance_criteria.then: The company name and logo are filled in
